subject: Civic Education
competence: Contributes to the building of national cohesion and sustainable peace safeguarding one's own cultural identity
lesson: Explains how sustainable peace brings about the national development: Mock Local Council / Pradeshiya Sabha Session: Competency Level 8.3.3
unique_learning_outcome: Explains how sustainable peace brings about the national development.
Explains the importance of building sustainable peace in a multicultural society.
the_entrance: Duration: Exactly 5 minutes. Teacher action: Welcomes the 40 students, writes the lesson title on the chalkboard, and introduces a short real-world scenario of a multicultural community deciding on a local development project. Student action: Listens attentively, recalls prior experiences of community cooperation, and links daily harmony to national progress. The teacher transitions directly into organizing the 8 teams for the mock council activity.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Organizes the 40 students into 8 teams of 5. Assigns specific roles (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) to ensure no bystanders. Distributes prompt cards outlining a local council dilemma regarding community resource allocation and national development.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students assemble into their 8 designated teams, assume their roles, inspect the prompt cards, and clarify their team responsibilities with the teacher.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Circulates across all 8 teams, providing outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Facilitates role execution, ensuring Leaders guide discussions, Scribes record arguments, Timekeepers monitor the 15-minute pacing, Spokespersons prepare summaries, and Civic Investigators check alignment with textbook facts.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Team members actively execute their roles: the Leader moderates discussion on how sustainable peace drives national development, the Scribe notes down key points, the Timekeeper keeps track of time, the Civic Investigator checks textbook concepts, and the team agrees on a reasoned decision written on chart paper.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Coordinates brief presentations from team Spokespersons and moderates the peer feedback session, highlighting common themes on sustainable peace and national development.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Spokespersons present their group's resolution to the class. Other teams listen critically, ask questions, and offer constructive peer feedback on the proposed civic decisions.

summary: Consolidation and synthesis of key concepts: The teacher summarizes how mutual understanding and sustainable peace directly contribute to national development, reinforcing that working unitedly across cultural diversities is essential for progress.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Final closure formative assessment evaluating student participation across roles and the accuracy of group resolutions regarding peace and national development.
post_activity: Duration: Exactly 5 minutes. In-class assignment: Each student writes a single sentence in their notebook summarizing how sustainable peace enables national development, which is collected immediately by the Timekeeper.
